recognitions.text: One of the European data resources ELIXIR considers of fundamental importance to the wider life-science community and to the long-term preservation of biological data.
A repository ELIXIR recommends for depositing life-science experimental data.

A tool, registry or standard selected by external reviewers for ELIXIR’s Interoperability Platform because it helps make research FAIR – for example by linking data resources or exposing their metadata.

Recognised by the Global Biodata Coalition as a biodata resource of fundamental importance to the biological and life sciences community worldwide and to the long-term preservation of biological data.
